name: Gaerolas Talvethren
summary: At Starbreeze Village, Gaerolas Talvethren guards the Sleeping druids in troubled Teldrassil. He seeks aid against aggressive furbolgs and corruption spreading through the boughs.

sections.title: Guardian of the Sleeping
sections.body: Gaerolas Talvethren guards the Sleeping druids at Starbreeze Village. They slumber in communion with the Emerald Dream, and his watch has grown uneasy as unnatural corruption spreads through the forest and unsettles Teldrassil.

sections.title: The Gnarlpine Menace
sections.body: Gaerolas calls on travelers to push back the Gnarlpine furbolgs, whose minds have turned to madness and savagery. He hopes to uncover the taint spreading from their shamans and the roots of their distress, preserving what sanctity remains in eastern Teldrassil.

faq.answer: Gaerolas Talvethren is a night elf defender at Starbreeze Village, charged with guarding the Sleeping druids and investigating the strange corruption afflicting the area.

faq.q: Where can I find Gaerolas Talvethren?
faq.answer: You can find Gaerolas Talvethren in Starbreeze Village, in eastern Teldrassil, east of Dolanaar.

faq.q: Who are 'the Sleeping' that Gaerolas protects?
faq.answer: The Sleeping are night elf druids who entered long slumbers in barrows and sanctuaries to traverse the Emerald Dream, leaving their physical forms vulnerable to harm.

faq.q: What threats is Gaerolas concerned about?
faq.answer: Gaerolas is troubled by corruption afflicting local wildlife and the Gnarlpine furbolgs' sudden, maddened hostility.

angles.text: As a young night elf leaving Dolanaar, helping Gaerolas shows how deeply the taint has spread through Teldrassil's sacred boughs.
As a druid, Gaerolas's duty to guard the slumbering druids makes helping him a personal matter: you protect fellow practitioners of the Cenarion Circle.
